inputs.question: Measuring from the overhead electric conductor line along the southern boundary to the centers of the proposed trees (M - Mitigation Trees) positioned near or adjacent to this line, what are the estimated lateral (horizontal) distances? Are any proposed trees closer than 15 feet from the conductor?
inputs.checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.regionHint: southern boundary of the site where the overhead electric line is shown and proposed mitigation trees are located adjacent to or near this line
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent is directly asking for lateral distance measurements from the OHE conductor to tree centers and whether any trees fall within the 15-foot compliance threshold. This is the core measurement task required by the checklist requirement.
